title: pfaffia lanata var. oblongifolia
intro: Pfaffia lanata var. oblongifolia, commonly known as "suma", is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. The suma plant has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of suma include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of suma include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
